== Card credits ==
Dirk Friedrichs is credited on [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards]] with the original concept of three cards.<ref name="labels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images. Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The printed concept credit names the tournament or award with the concept: "European MPC 2008" on •Lone Pilot (V) ([[Virtual Block 6]]). The credits on •Kit Fisto ([[Virtual Set 10]]) and •Kit Fisto (Holo AI) ([[Virtual Set 10]]) also name [[Chris Menzel|Chris Menzel]]. The credited cards were printed in [[Virtual Block 6]] (2009) and [[Virtual Set 10]] (2019), so the credited cards span 2009–2019. The full list of people credited on Virtual cards is at [[Card Credits#Dirk Friedrichs|Card Credits]].
